binders: A dimension m, real ratio r, arbitrary numerical-flux operator, cell-average sequence, and natural cellCount.
conclusions: The sum of updates for i=0,...,cellCount-1 equals the sum of the old cell averages minus r times the boundary-flux difference numericalFlux(U,cellCount)-numericalFlux(U,0).
translation.proposition_plain_english: Summing the conservative flux-difference update over a finite contiguous block telescopes all interior edge fluxes, leaving only the right boundary flux minus the left boundary flux.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: No positivity or CFL restriction is imposed on r.
The numerical flux and cell values are completely arbitrary; the result is purely algebraic telescoping.
cellCount may be zero and m may be zero.
No time-level relation, consistency, stability, accuracy, or convergence property is encoded.
